source.method: Shopify Admin GraphQL through the Shopify connector (graphql_query, read-only). No mutations.
source.personalData: None. No customer, order, staff or author fields were queried.

scope: Every product in every status (status:active,draft,archived,unlisted; productsCount 14, all pages read).
notes: publications lists every APP-catalog publication the product is added to (onlyPublished:false); a channel missing from the list means the product is not added to it.
marketCatalogPublications are the MARKET catalogs (Canada, US, International).
inventoryQuantity is summed across locations by Shopify; totalInventory is Shopify's own product total.
